# Mono

> Mono is a private, sign-in-only personal journal and productivity app (Next.js + Appwrite). It has no public content to index or cite.

- The only public route is `/auth` (email-code sign-in).
- Everything else — journal, year-in-dots, Today, profile, settings — requires an account and is intentionally not crawlable.
- The site does not publish articles, docs, pricing, or marketing pages, so AI assistants should not expect public facts to quote beyond this description.
